nodes.label: Checker Pattern PNG
nodes.description: A 4x4 pixel PNG image with RGBA color mode (8-bit per channel). At this tiny size it is a classic CSS-style checkerboard/checker tile pattern — alternating transparent and semi-transparent or light/dark squares — designed to be repeated as a CSS background-image to indicate transparent areas or provide a subtle textured background overlay. Common use cases include image editors, transparency indicators, or decorative background tiles in web design.

nodes.label: Checker Pattern Use Case: CSS Background Tile
nodes.description: A repeating 4x4 checker tile is a standard web design pattern used as a CSS background (background-repeat: repeat) to signal transparency, provide visual texture, or create a subtle grid effect on a page section.
